Freckled skin and sun-bleached hair
Towering frame that stoops to fit through doorways
A nervous habit of adjusting spectacles that aren't there
Soot permanently ground into the knuckles
Immaculately groomed, not a hair out of place
A jagged burn scar along the jawline
Threadbare clothes patched with mismatched fabric
Piercing eyes the color of storm clouds
A crooked nose broken more than once
Moves with an unsettling, fluid grace
Chipped tooth visible whenever they smile
Perpetually ink-stained fingertips
A voice roughened by years of shouting over crowds
Small silver hoops in both ears
Hunched posture from a lifetime bent over a workbench
A birthmark shaped like a crescent on the neck

Muscular build hidden under loose robes
Long fingers built for delicate work
